transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. We need to conduct the mandatory round-robin sign-off for the televised opening-night tribute broadcast operating plan before I can approve anything. As you know, the tribute is scheduled for 9:00 PM in the Grand Lyric Theater, and the draft plan calls for an eight-minute in-person full-band performance with a 90-second song excerpt, a confetti drop, and four stagehands. I'll need each of you — technical, rights, talent, and safety leads — to state your exact final operating requirement for your area and name one concrete update you will enter in the production records. Let's start with the technical lead. What is your final operating requirement and your production-records update?
